acceptance_criteria: Camera is mounted at the intended deployment height and angle; front-vehicle dashcam views are rejected.
notes: Use the same ROI definition planned for deployment.

acceptance_criteria: At least one independent BACKLIT session is mandatory; target two sessions on different times/days.
notes: Keep complete session boundaries and stable session IDs.

acceptance_criteria: Contact sheet visibly shows the strong source behind/near vehicles; mean brightness alone is not accepted.
notes: Reviewer and review date are required.

acceptance_criteria: Record a comparable normal-day session to separate backlight impact from general daylight.
notes: Do not relabel bright DAY frames as BACKLIT.

acceptance_criteria: Include safe moving/slow/stopped cases and frames with no vehicle in ROI.
notes: Never stage a stop on an active dangerous lane.

acceptance_criteria: Include car and motorbike when safely available; record missing types explicitly.
Every evaluation frame has reviewed boxes plus session_id lighting weather camera_view road_type and ROI metadata.
notes: Preserve original class for per-type analysis.

acceptance_criteria: Entire BACKLIT session is locked in MAIN_K230_TEST and absent from train/validation.
notes: Run sequence/source/hash leakage checks before evaluation.

acceptance_criteria: Report mAP only after ground truth and model predictions exist; otherwise keep NOT_AVAILABLE.
notes: Never convert missing evaluation to zero.

acceptance_criteria: Location and procedure are approved; public evidence is privacy reviewed/pixelated.
notes: Stop recording if traffic or equipment safety is at risk.
